observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same two-burner tabletop gas cooker from a top-down angle.
The cooktop has a black glass surface with a white and red floral design.
Both burners have visible grates and central burners; some rust or discoloration is present on the inner parts of the burners.
The brand 'SAFIC' is visible in the bottom right corner of the cooktop in both photos.
There are no visible control knobs in the photos, though a knob is partially visible on the right edge in both images.
The surface shows minor smudges and reflections, suggesting use or handling.
Watermark 'FIRSTELITE ENTERPRISES' is overlaid on both photos.
No model number is visible on the cooktop or side panels.

claims.claim: Premium modern table top gas cooker
claims.evidence: The term 'premium' and 'modern' are subjective; the photos show a standard two-burner gas cooker with a floral design, which may not be considered premium. No features like digital controls, safety shut-off, or high BTU are visible.
This is a logistical claim that cannot be verified from photos alone.

risks.risk: The gas cooker may not be functional or may have damaged burners or gas valves.
risks.proof: A video showing the cooktop being lit and burning steadily on both burners, or a close-up of the gas valve and control knobs.

risks.risk: The cooktop surface may have cracks or deep scratches not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the glass surface under direct light, showing any cracks or chips.

risks.risk: The control knobs may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A side view or close-up of the control knobs showing their condition and presence.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing or broken controls

proof_requests: A video showing both burners lit and burning steadily.
A close-up photo of the control knobs and gas valve area.
A close-up photo of the glass surface under direct light to check for cracks or chips.
response.reason: The brand is identifiable as SAFIC, but the model is not visible. The seller's claims of 'premium' and 'modern' are subjective and unverified. Critical functional and physical risks (functionality, surface damage, control knobs) cannot be assessed from the current photos. Proof is needed to determine if the item is functional and in good condition.
